about_the_game:
Subnautic Raider is a 2D steampunk action and arcade-style submarine game with a strong focus on combat and economic management. Take command of your submarine and engage in daring missions across the oceans, upgrading your vessel, selecting from a variety of missiles, and managing fuel, oxygen, and various systems.

Key features:

  • Steampunk submarine action: Navigate your vessel underwater, avoiding detection and engaging enemy ships.

  • Variety of missions: Eliminate enemy fleets, perform reconnaissance, survive dangerous encounters, and reach critical coordinates.

  • Tactical upgrades: Customize your submarines with better armor, weapons, speed, stealth technology, etc.

  • Dynamic combat: Fire torpedoes and missiles; manage reloads and strategic timing.

  • Resource management: Balance oxygen, fuel, ammunition, and speed to complete missions efficiently.

  • Immersive UI & visuals: Handcrafted steampunk-inspired dashboards, gauges, and animated indicators.

  • Procedurally simulated ocean: Navigate seas populated by transport and military ships, each with AI behaviors and sonar detection.

  • Expandable arsenal: Equip and upgrade 20+ different missile types with unique properties.

Subnautic Raider combines quick tactical decisions with long-term strategy. Plan each mission, upgrade your submarines, and master underwater warfare in a visually rich steampunk world. This is just the beginning — more content and features will arrive as the game develops!
